QuestInfo.name: Umi and Fire Raccoon Finance
QuestInfo.0: #p9120005# in Showa Town is looking for someone to solve her problem. Apparently she spent money to put a help wanted ad in the newspaper.
QuestInfo.1:
#p9120005# has tasked you with finding her an especially spacious wallet. She mentioned a big toad living in Ninja Castle. Perhaps Gigatoad's wallet will suffice. It won't be an easy battle.


#t04000346#   #b#c04000346##k/1
QuestInfo.2: #p9120005# might be the richest person in Showa Town.

0.0: Sigh, I'm at my wit's end!
0.1: The sales from the vegetable shop aren't much, but our partnership with Fire Raccoon Finance is quite lucrative.
0.2: What partnership you ask? Well, we have multiple contracts. For example, we supply Fire Raccoon Finance's restaurant franchises, and we have carts selling vegetables right outside Fire Raccoon Finance. But 60% of our revenue comes from the 'other' agreement.
0.3: You could call it seed money. Vegetable seeds, that is. We source seeds of rare vegetables growing wild in mountainous regions cheaply and freeze them. Their value fluctuates wildly over the seasons, and we resell them later at a higher price.
0.4: Fire Raccoon Finance handles all the details. Although they take the larger share of the revenue, I've still made quite a profit!
0.5: So what am I so troubled by, you might ask?
0.6: There's not enough room for in my wallet for all the money! I don't use credit cards, so I've got to carry my cash with me.
0.7: I'm going to need a bigger wallet.
0.8: If you can find me a wallet large enough for my fortune, I'll reward you handsomely.

yes.0: Thanks! There's no way I can fit yacht-buying money in my current wallet.
yes.1: I need a wallet that can hold 60 million mesos. I want to buy a really nice mount!
yes.3: What are you saying? I'll need to purchase at least 3 mounts. One for everyday use. One for aesthetics, and one for when the first one is out of commission.
yes.4: Where can you find such a wallet?
yes.5: I've heard on a trivia show that Gigatoad has a huge wallet. Of course it won't be easy to obtain, since the toad lives in a castle somewhere.
yes.6: But you look strong. I'm sure you can retrieve the wallet. Good luck!

1.0: Can you bring me a wallet that fits 60 million mesos?
1.1: Oh, look! This is amazing! It's a lucky shade of red, and the embroidery is impeccable. I'm sure it was made by a legendary craftsman.
1.2: I'm going to stuff it with money and pay Kenta a visit. Here is your reward!
